org.asynchttpclient.filter

Class ThrottleRequestFilter

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.asynchttpclient.filter.ThrottleRequestFilter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    RequestFilter

    public class ThrottleRequestFilter
extends Object
implements RequestFilter
    A RequestFilter throttles requests and block when the number of permits is reached, waiting for the response to arrives before executing the next request.

      <T> FilterContext<T> filter(FilterContext<T> ctx)
      An AsyncHttpClient will invoke RequestFilter.filter(org.asynchttpclient.filter.FilterContext<T>) and will use the returned FilterContext.getRequest() and FilterContext.getAsyncHandler() to continue the request processing.

      • filter

        public <T> FilterContext<T> filter(FilterContext<T> ctx)
                            throws FilterException
        An AsyncHttpClient will invoke RequestFilter.filter(org.asynchttpclient.filter.FilterContext<T>) and will use the returned FilterContext.getRequest() and FilterContext.getAsyncHandler() to continue the request processing.
        Specified by:
        filter in interface RequestFilter
        Type Parameters:
        T - the handler result type
        Parameters:
        ctx - a FilterContext
        Returns:
        FilterContext. The FilterContext instance may not the same as the original one.
        Throws:
        FilterException - to interrupt the filter processing.
